o.text: Borrowed from Russian компью́тер (kompʹjúter), from English computer.
From Persian دستاقخانه (dostâqxâne). By surface analysis, dustaq (“prisoner”) + -xana.
Borrowed from Arabic تَأْكِيدًا (taʔkīdan), adverbial accusative of تَأْكِيد (taʔkīd). By surface analysis, təkid + -ən.
Blend of zillət (“ordeal, oppression”) + millət vəkili (“deputy, assemblyman”). By surface analysis, izafet II compound of zillət + vəkil.
Borrowed from Russian электрокардио́граф (elektrokardiógraf). By surface analysis, elektro- + kardioqraf.
